findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application only supports PHP session-based authentication via username/password login. No OAuth2 client credentials, API key, mTLS, or service account mechanism exists.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. Agents cannot authenticate with attributable service credentials.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication as a parallel auth path with per-agent identity attribution.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints use uniqid() for ID generation with no idempotency key support. POST /api/orders creates a new order every invocation with no duplicate detection.
findings.gap: No idempotency keys, no duplicate detection, no idempotent behavior on retry for any write endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Add Idempotency-Key header support to critical write endpoints (order creation, shipping, return approval).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism exists on any write endpoint.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents retry on failure and LLM non-determinism causes duplicate tool calls. Without idempotency keys, repeated POST /api/orders creates duplicate orders.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add Idempotency-Key header support to order creation endpoint
blocker_remediation.target_state: All POST endpoints accept idempotency key and return cached results on duplicate

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: Order status changes are logged to a mutable MySQL table (order_status_history). No CloudTrail, no immutable storage, no tamper-evident logging. VPC Flow Logs exist but are network-level only.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit trail for write operations.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail with S3 Object Lock for immutable log storage. Log authenticated principal for every write operation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no immutable audit trail exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents require full audit attribution for compliance. The mutable order_status_history table can be modified or deleted, providing no forensic guarantee.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Multi-Step Workflows
findings.description: The 7-step fulfillment workflow (validate → assign-warehouse → pick → pack → quality-check → ship → deliver) has no compensation or rollback mechanism across steps. Single-step DB transactions exist but no cross-step compensation.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints for the multi-step fulfillment workflow.
findings.recommendation: Implement compensating actions for each fulfillment step (e.g., unassign-warehouse, cancel-shipment) or adopt a saga pattern.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation exists for multi-step fulfillment workflow.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: An agent executing the 7-step fulfillment workflow may succeed on steps 1-4 and fail on step 5, leaving the order in unrecoverable partial state.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Customer PII (names, emails, shipping addresses) stored in RDS with no data residency documentation, no cross-region transfer controls, and no data sovereignty policy for agent-LLM interactions.
findings.gap: No data residency documentation, no cross-region transfer controls, no sovereignty policy.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Classify which fields may be sent to LLM providers. Configure VPC endpoints to restrict data egress.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND customer PII stored with no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agent may transmit customer PII (emails, addresses) to an LLM endpoint in another jurisdiction without documented authorization, creating potential GDPR/privacy law violations.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Binary admin/customer roles only. No mechanism to create scoped agent identity with access limited to specific operations or resources.
findings.gap: No fine-grained permission scoping. Cannot restrict agent to specific endpoints or resources.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained RBAC with configurable permission sets per identity.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Authorization is role-level only. An admin can perform all operations with the same credential. No action-level granularity.
findings.gap: Cannot allow read but deny delete within admin scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement permission matrix with action-level checks.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No JWT/OAuth token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows, no identity propagation capability. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation or delegation mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange for on-behalf-of flows.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credential Fallbacks
findings.description: Database credentials have hardcoded fallback defaults in code. No secrets management system. No credential rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded 'ecommerce_pass' fallback. No AWS Secrets Manager or rotation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove hardcoded fallbacks.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend an agent identity without deleting it. User management supports only CRUD — no disable/suspend flag.
findings.gap: Cannot revoke agent access without full deletion.
findings.recommendation: Add is_active field to users table with enforcement on every request.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Multiple concurrent agents could create race conditions on inventory and order status.
findings.gap: No concurrency controls for write operations.
findings.recommendation: Add version field to orders table with optimistic locking.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: WAF is IP whitelist only, not rate limiting. No application-level throttling. A whitelisted agent could make unlimited requests.
findings.gap: No rate limiting at any layer.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rule and application-level throttling.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on agent-initiated actions. Agent could approve unlimited returns, delete all users, or ship all orders without caps.
findings.gap: No per-caller business transaction limits.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller business limits (max refunds/hour, max deletions/day).

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable per-operation approval gates. High-risk operations (ship, delete user, approve refund) execute immediately when called.
findings.gap: No configurable approval requirement per operation type.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations.

findings.title: No Access Control Differentiation for Sensitive Data
findings.description: System stores customer PII and payment records. Passwords are excluded from API responses (B1 clear). However, no access control differentiation exists between sensitive and non-sensitive data (B2 fires). Binary admin/customer roles grant access to everything.
findings.gap: No differentiated access controls for sensitive vs non-sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth scopes separating data domains (read:orders vs read:users vs read:payments).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: B1 clear (passwords excluded from API responses), B2 fires (no access control differentiation), B3 absent (INFO).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: B1 did not fire as BLOCKER because passwords are properly excluded. B2 fires because a single admin credential grants access to all sensitive data without scope differentiation.

b1.reasoning: Passwords excluded from API responses via explicit SELECT column list and unset($user['password'])

b2.reasoning: Binary admin/customer roles — no OAuth scopes or fine-grained data access controls

b3.reasoning: No formal classification metadata, no PII detection tooling

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction mechanism. Exception messages (potentially containing user data) are logged and returned to clients. No log scrubbing or masking.
findings.gap: No PII redaction in error logs or error responses.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize error responses. Implement log scrubbing for PII fields.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model exists. ~25 REST endpoints defined only in PHP code.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API specification for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all endpoints.

findings.title: Minimal Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses contain only an error message field with no error codes, retryable indicator, or field-level detail.
findings.gap: No structured error codes or retryable classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error responses with codes and retryable boolean.

findings.title: No Pagination or Filtering
findings.description: List endpoints return all records with no pagination, filtering, or sorting. SELECT * without LIMIT.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets on all list endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination parameters to all list endpoints.

findings.title: Minimal Input Validation
findings.description: Minimal validation (empty checks, prepared statements for injection protection). No schema enforcement, no validation framework, no field-level error responses.
findings.gap: No systematic input validation with structured error responses.
findings.recommendation: Implement request body validation with field-level error responses.

findings.title: No Timezone Normalization or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Timestamps present (created_at, updated_at) but use server timezone without explicit UTC. No freshness headers in API responses.
findings.gap: No UTC standardization. No staleness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Standardize UTC storage. Add Last-Modified and Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema files, no migration framework, no breaking change detection. Agent tool bindings break silently.
findings.gap: No versioning or contract testing for API stability.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and schema management with breaking change detection.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, trace ID propagation, structured JSON logging, or correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot debug agent-initiated requests through the system.
findings.recommendation: Implement X-Ray/OpenTelemetry with structured JSON logging and correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms for application metrics. RDS Enhanced Monitoring exists but no alerting thresholds configured.
findings.gap: No alerts for agent API anomalies or degradation.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for App Runner error rates and latency.

findings.title: Partial Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: CloudFormation IaC exists (comprehensive) but no CI/CD to enforce peer review and no drift detection configured.
findings.gap: IaC present (1/3 sub-checks). No peer review enforcement (2/3). No drift detection (3/3).
findings.recommendation: Add CI/CD pipeline with PR approval for IaC changes. Enable drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual via deploy.sh script. No automated testing or contract validation.
findings.gap: No automated deployment pipeline or API contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Explicit Rollback Capability
findings.description: No blue/green deployment, no canary, no feature flags. Only App Runner health check failure provides basic protection.
findings.gap: No automated rollback for breaking API changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with rollback triggers.

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: Zero automated tests. No test framework configured. No PHPUnit, no Postman collections, no integration tests.
findings.gap: No test coverage for any API endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suite covering agent-facing endpoints.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: State changes recorded in order_status_history DB table only. No webhooks, SNS/SQS/EventBridge, or event streaming.
findings.gap: No push-based notification for state changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement SNS/EventBridge for order status transitions.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation, no X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers. Agents cannot self-throttle.
findings.gap: No rate limit visibility for agent callers.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and add rate limit response headers.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or completeness monitoring for production data.
findings.gap: No quality metrics for data agents consume.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring for critical fields.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or external schema documentation. Schema defined inline in PHP only.
findings.gap: No machine-readable data documentation.
findings.recommendation: Document schema in JSON Schema or data dictionary format.

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Only infrastructure-level monitoring (RDS Enhanced Monitoring, VPC Flow Logs).
findings.gap: Cannot measure agent business impact.
findings.recommendation: Implement custom CloudWatch metrics for fulfillment rate, delivery time, return rate.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: Application exposes REST API with ~25 JSON endpoints accessible via HTTP. No direct DB access or UI automation required.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All API responses use JSON with Content-Type: application/json header.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations >30s or long-running workflows detected.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: GET endpoints exist for order state, validation data, picking details, warehouse options, and order history.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — monolith has no external service dependencies.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified, not explicitly on critical path.

evaluations.title: Draft/Pending State
evaluations.reason: Returns use pending_review status requiring admin approval. Fulfillment workflow has intermediate states before final commitment.

evaluations.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
evaluations.reason: Docker-compose with MySQL and seed data provides local testing environment with production-equivalent data shape.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: All field names are semantically clear: customer_id, customer_name, total_amount, shipping_address, tracking_number, stock_quantity.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: RDS StorageEncrypted: true, ECR KMS encryption, VPC Flow Logs KMS encrypted.

items.summary: Resolve all 5 blockers (machine identity, idempotency, audit logging, compensation, data residency) and address critical safety risks (permissions, concurrency, rate limiting, PII protection).
Address remaining safety risks and quality improvements including API specification, observability, CI/CD pipeline, and deployment maturity.
Implement test coverage, event emission, rate limit documentation, data quality monitoring, and business metrics.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity authentication (API keys or OAuth2 client credentials)
recommended_actions.rationale: Foundation for all other auth controls. Without machine identity, no other security control can be properly attributed.

recommended_actions.action: Add idempotency key support to write endpoints
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents duplicate orders, payments, and shipments from agent retries and LLM non-determinism.

recommended_actions.action: Implement immutable audit logging with CloudTrail
recommended_actions.rationale: Compliance requirement for write-enabled agents. Enables forensics and accountability.

recommended_actions.action: Implement saga pattern with compensating transactions
recommended_actions.rationale: Multi-step fulfillment workflow needs rollback capability to prevent partial state corruption.

recommended_actions.action: Document data residency policy and implement data filtering
recommended_actions.rationale: Customer PII requires documented position on cross-border data transmission to LLM providers.
